decisions.reason: The indoor air quality sensor module continues to address growing demand for air quality monitoring and has no indicated replacement, so we keep it with low drop probability.
As the current version of a core voltage measurement module, it is likely to remain in the portfolio, hence a very low drop probability and keep.
CAN bus interfaces are standard industrial interfaces and the module likely still has steady demand, so we keep it with a moderate drop probability.
The CO2 sensor module benefits from increased attention to ventilation and indoor CO2 levels, so we keep it with low drop probability.
